fail_closed_rules: Withdrawn Prior and Withdrawn Post are not represented as completed sales or current availability.
Unreadable official update endpoints are not reconstructed or guessed.
Subject-to-contract lease extensions are not represented as executed current leases.
Past-due and future RPI or open-market reviews are not silently converted into current rents.
Turnover sublease rent, headlease rent, ground rent and occupational rent remain separate.
Peppercorn and residential ground rents are not represented as occupational income.
Tenant and mutual options are not represented as exercised or waived.
Vacant properties and accommodation are not represented as let or income-producing.
Planning and development potential are not represented as implemented, consented or valued outcomes.
Active company status and registered charges do not imply covenant strength or property-level lease performance.
Legal-pack EPC, title, update and lease details are not filled by inference.
No business or parcel row was written by the maintenance/control slot.
